subtitle: Four directions for the Footnote product page: Library, Memory and, later, Code. Pick a base, tune it with the controls, write notes, then lock it. The lock becomes the approved DESIGN.md.

preview.headline: Every answer comes with its source
preview.lede: Local memory for Claude Code, Codex, Grok and DeepSeek. Footnote indexes your documents, remembers how you work, and cites the file, the line and whether it changed since.

features: Large document collections, first indexing then daily sync. Best quality on all five corpora tested.
Preferences, decisions, fixes and sessions, shared by every agent you use. One command installs it.
